semantic_contract.job_to_be_done: Help an early-stage VC operator structure local project materials into evidence-first diligence artifacts without replacing investment judgment.
should_trigger: User asks for jvc-prefixed diligence skills
User asks to structure project decks, interviews, market sizing, comps, return models, IC memo drafts, or invoice archives using this toolkit
should_not_trigger: Pure teaching or explanation requests with no reusable output artifact
Uploading private deal materials to third-party web tools
General accounting workflows outside jvc-invoice-manager boundaries
semantic_contract.trust_boundary: Local-first repository. Raw deal materials stay local; shipped scripts may read/write local files but do not include network-capable code.

skills.name: jvc-deal-flow
skills.job: Initialize, resume, inspect, and advance a local deal project through the minimum sufficient diligence stages while preserving human gates.
failure_modes: Turns optional skills into a fixed pipeline

skills.name: jvc-prescreen
skills.job: Create a low-precision screen of the business model, value chain, track validity, top-down market range, five-year revenue, and transaction return without making a final investment decision.
failure_modes: Invents a market number without an anchor
Calculates revenue or return without an identifiable customer, payer, and product

skills.name: jvc-bull-case
skills.job: Extract positive investment arguments with evidence and verification gaps.
failure_modes: Mixes unsupported intuition into verified highlights

skills.name: jvc-bear-case
skills.job: Run role-based adversarial review from LP, competitor CEO, skeptical peer, and IC boss perspectives.

skills.name: jvc-track-research
skills.job: Build a first-pass investment research map that uses lifecycle-weighted hypotheses, causal evidence, and cycle positioning to prioritize subsequent diligence.
failure_modes: Milestones and commercialization claims are mixed
Recent trends are linearly extrapolated or presented as precise cycle forecasts
Generic industry summary omits falsifiers and next-skill handoff

skills.name: jvc-research-report
skills.job: 组装（Assemble）已审计的赛道级上游（Track Research、Knowledge Tree、Market Sizing、可选 Comps/DD）为 canonical research-report.md，再校验并渲染为品牌化 PDF 与 HTML 预览；不新增事实、不联网补研究；已有完整 canonical research-report.md 时可直接发布。
failure_modes: Overwrites a previous successful build after failure

skills.name: jvc-knowledge-tree-builder
skills.job: Convert existing local VC track, project, Obsidian, or source folders into recursive knowledge tree artifacts with evidence and open questions.
failure_modes: Mixes investment conclusion with knowledge structure

skills.name: jvc-comps-dd
skills.job: Research competitors, comparables, upstream/downstream, and overseas benchmarks into a source-backed Markdown comparison note.
failure_modes: Public market cap and private financing valuation mixed as one metric

skills.name: jvc-market-sizing
skills.job: Build top-down and bottom-up TAM/SAM/SOM models with reconciliation and orthogonality checks; the single authoritative artifact is the audited market-sizing.csv.

skills.name: jvc-roi-modeler
skills.job: Replicate the user-provided return model logic for investment terms, financing dilution, three exit scenarios, MOIC, cumulative return, and IRR.
failure_modes: Uses net gain instead of gross proceeds in terminal IRR cash flow
Reports MOIC times 100 percent as cumulative return

skills.name: jvc-ic-memo
skills.job: Synthesize prior diligence into an audited IC memo pre-review, stop for explicit user approval, then produce a clean Markdown final without visible evidence metadata.
failure_modes: Leaks citations, evidence status, gaps, or quality reports into the final
Adds facts or numbers during final conversion
Overwrites the last successful final after failed validation

skills.name: jvc-meeting-notes
skills.job: Generate a six-section factual DOCX interview note from transcript and user notes.

skills.name: jvc-talk-notes
skills.job: Generate Q&A-style DOCX interview notes with complete answers, fact dimensions, and validation gaps.
failure_modes: Puts Q headings in body content

skills.name: jvc-research-core
skills.job: Maintain one append-only evidence registry and deterministically audit calling-skill artifacts.
failure_modes: Unverified company claim promoted to fact

skills.name: jvc-invoice-manager
skills.job: OCR PDF invoices, require human confirmation, generate reimbursement Excel, and copy PDFs into archive folders.
failure_modes: Uses unreviewed OCR as final truth
Leaks invoice data into investment judgment

evals.evidence_level: deterministic fixture evidence; model-executed evidence is missing evidence
